title: loam run status --json
description: A run and its history, oldest first, with the failed checks of its last gate and the findings of its last code review.

failed_checks.description: The checks that failed in the last gate of the run, in the order that they ran: the last block of check events. Empty when that gate passed or the run has none.

code_review.description: What the last code review of the run found: the round of its last code_review event. Null when that review did not run or was off, or the run has none.
